displayName: 利姆露·特恩佩斯特 Rimuru Tempest
description: Unofficial Rimuru Tempest fan art from That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime, exclusively in pale-blue slime form. The limbless companion catches a water drop, gently pockets and releases a smooth pebble, and balances a leaf with soft ripples. Nine states use directional soft-body deformation, a squash-and-spring jump, and gentle leaf-catching recovery.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
